patch_description: This approach replaces the simple layer-based rotation-entanglement structure with a more sophisticated SU(4) block construction. Instead of alternating rigid rotation layers and entanglement layers, it interleaves local rotations with controlled-Z gates in a specific, dense pattern that effectively mimics a hardware-efficient SU(4) block. The design is intended to maximize the expressivity of the circuit by using controlled-rotations (`CRZ`) which provide conditional entanglement and rotation simultaneously, combined with standard single-qubit rotations. By optimizing the connectivity to focus on both local correlation and global information propagation, we achieve higher accuracy with a well-controlled parameter count.
